Yes, the Read Later flow matches what I wanted. I can mark something to read later and see it flip clearly, there's a dedicated place — reachable from the side — that holds just my unfinished reading, marking something read clears it from that pile without throwing the bookmark away, and when I'm caught up I get a reassuring empty view instead of a confusing blank. That's the whole "keep my meant-to-read stuff visible and separate" idea I described at the very start, done the way I hoped.

So that piece is settled for me. That covers the three big things I came in wanting — effortless saving, easy finding, and a read-later spot.
